title: malvastrum scabrum var. genuinum
intro: Malvastrum scabrum var. genuinum, commonly known as a variety of the Malvastrum scabrum plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Malvaceae. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may help in soothing skin irritations and wounds. Malvastrum scabrum var. genuinum is said to possess therapeutic actions like astringency, anti-edematous, and hemostatic properties, making it useful in treating various skin conditions and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Malvastrum scabrum var. genuinum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
